entries.t: <FACE:22>Everyone, listen up…<NL><WAIT>Calm down, calm down…<NL>Especially right now…
<FACE:3D>Are you kidding me!?<NL><WAIT>No adults on this<NL>Cluster, just us!
<FACE:3D>Even now Earth's<NL>getting farther away!<WAIT>And there's a rumor it<NL>was terrorists!
<FACE:22>From now on, please<NL>follow my orders<WAIT>As class president, I<NL>will take command<WAIT>Now then, first…
<FACE:22>From today, you're on<NL>food duty!<WAIT>Gather the park's food<NL>and hand it all out!
<FACE:22>(Phew, that was close<NL>what was I thinking!)<WAIT>(Talking to Amamiya,<NL>the school bully!)
<FACE:45>What's your problem!?<NL><WAIT>What right do you have<NL>to order us around?
<FACE:45>And seriously, what's<NL>with that tacky look!<WAIT>Wanna talk to us?<NL><WAIT>Work on your fashion<NL>sense first!<WAIT><FACE:47>Yeah! You're so wimpy<NL>it's just sad!
<FACE:45>Guys like you make me<NL>sick just to look at!<WAIT>We'll do our own thing<NL><WAIT>Later!
<FACE:05>How long's he gonna<NL>keep that up?<WAIT>Nobody listens to the<NL>president anyway
<FACE:04>That's mean, Hiyori<NL><WAIT>He's trying his best<NL>too, y'know
<FACE:06>You are way too nice,<NL>you know that?<WAIT>He made your life<NL>miserable, remember?<WAIT><FACE:02>Well, that's all in<NL>the past now…
<FACE:35>We've each got to look<NL>out for ourselves
<FACE:25>U-um, hold on, you…!<NL><WAIT>I am your leader, so…<NL>
<FACE:22><PLAYER>!<NL><WAIT>You took the class<NL>president's armband,<WAIT>so now YOU are the<NL>class president!<WAIT>You must take charge<NL>and lead everyone!<WAIT><FACE:03>Whaaat?!
<FACE:24>Understood?<NL>You are the leader!<WAIT><FACE:03>W-what are you saying<NL>all of a sudden!?
<FACE:14>Just so ya know…<NL><WAIT>I ain't listening to<NL>a word you say!<WAIT><FACE:1A>Same goes for me!
<FACE:05>Kids these days and<NL>«teamwork»? No chance<WAIT><FACE:07>Well, chin up. Just do<NL>what you can
<FACE:04>Where should we go?<WAIT><FACE:09>Hmm, let me see…<NL>
<FACE:05>Up ahead is a Computer<NL>Block running it all<WAIT>Let's head there first<NL>Might learn something<WAIT><FACE:00>Right, let's go see
